verses.text: Ayik wan yalan winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a heb' anima, ix k'och heb' winh sacerdote, winh yajalil heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios yet' heb' winh saduceo.
Ix kot yowal heb' winh, yujto a winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi', wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh. Wan yalan heb' winh to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, yujto icha chi' ix aj spitzwixi Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yamji heb' winh yuj heb' winh, ix ak'jioch heb' winh t'a preso. Yujto yemxo k'ualil, yuj chi' jun ak'wal ix ochkan heb' winh.
Palta a wal heb' ix ab'an slolonel Dios t'a skal heb' anima chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool. Yuj chi' ix te q'uib' sb'isul heb' creyente. Ha sb'isul heb' winh winak, ay am oyeok mil.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh sat yajal t'a Jerusalén chi', heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés.
Ajun winhaj Anás, winh sat sacerdote ix k'ochpax yet' heb' winh, hanhejtona' ix k'ochpax winhaj Caifás, winhaj Juan yet' winhaj Alejandro yet' jantaknhej heb' sk'ab' yok heb' winh sat sacerdote.

Ix b'at yak'an ik'jokkot winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a yichanh heb' winh. Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a heb' winh: --¿B'ajtil ix eyik' jun eyopisio tik yik tze k'ulan juntzanh tik? ¿Mach tz'ak'an he k'ulok? xchi heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', te ayoch Yespíritu Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: --Ex yajal heyaj t'a heb' chonhab' yet' ex yichamtak winakil israel,
tze k'anb'ej t'ayonh, yujto ay jun wach'il ix kak' t'a jun winh max yaltaxon sb'ey tik, tekan he gana tzeyab'i tas ix aj sb'oxi winh.

Yuj chi' a jun tik ol kal t'ayex, yik ol yojtakejel heb' ketisraelal smasanil. Ha winh ix jawi t'a eyichanh tik, ix b'oxi winh yujnhej spoder Jesucristo aj Nazaret, haton jun ix he kulusejk'ei. Palta haxo Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Ha ex tik, icha junok b'oum pat, icha chi' eyaji. Haxo Jesús, icha k'een k'een alb'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani to malaj tz'och t'ayex. Palta haxo ix och yopisio, icha k'een k'een ix och sjolomok chikin pat.
Malaj junokxo mach syal onh skolani, yujto ha t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj junokxo mach ix ak'ji yopisio yuj Dios yak'an ko kolnab'il, anhej wal Jesús, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Haxo ix yilan heb' winh yajal chi' to ix stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Pedro chi' yet' winhaj Juan yalani. Ix yilanpax heb' winh to manh k'ayb'ab'ilok heb' winh, komon anima heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix te sat sk'ool heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix nachajel yuj heb' winh to junnhej ek'nak heb' winh yet' Jesús.
Ix yilanpax heb' winh to linhanoch winh ix b'oxi yok chi' t'a stz'ey heb' winh. Yuj chi' maj yal yak'anoch junok tas heb' winh t'a yib'anh heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh to tz'ik'jiel winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh, yakb'an slolon kan heb' winh sch'okoj.

Ixnhej elta heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas wal skutej heb' winh schawanhil tze na'a? Yujto yojtaknhej heb' aj Jerusalén tik to ix sb'o jun niwan milagro heb' winh. Yuj chi' max yal kalani to es.
Haxo tiknaik, yik max spukel jun ab'ix tik heb' winh t'a skal heb' anima, ko xib'tejek heb' winh, yik wach' manhxo ol yalel yab'ixal Jesucristo heb' winh t'a junokxo anima, xchi heb' winh yajal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtanxioch heb' winh heb' winh. Ix yalan wal heb' winh t'a heb' winh to manhxa b'ak'uinh syalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh, manhxa pax b'ak'uinh sk'ayb'ej heb' anima heb' winh t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al chi'.

Palta haxo ix tak'wi winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Scham wal he naani. ¿Tom wach' t'a sat Dios tze na'a, tato a heyik chi' sko k'anab'ajej, haxo Dios max ko k'anab'ajej tas syala'?
Yuj chi', max yal kaktan kalanel yab'ixal tas ix kila' yet' tas ix kab'i, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ix wach' xib'taj heb' winh yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'jiel heb' winh t'a libre. Max nachaj yuj heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh yak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Yujto masanil heb' chonhab' wan yalan wach' lolonel t'a Dios yuj jun ix sk'ulej heb' winh chi'.
Ha winh ix b'oxi yok chi', másxo 40 ab'il sk'inal winh.

Ixlajwi yak'jiel winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' t'a libre, ix b'at heb' winh. Ix k'ochxi heb' winh b'aj aykan juntzanhxo heb' yetb'eyum. Ix laj yalan heb' winh jantak tas ix yal heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio.

Haxo ix yab'an heb' yetb'eyum heb' winh chi', junnhej molanh ix aj slesalwi heb' t'a Dios. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, ach ko Diosal, a ach a b'onak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik, ha' mar yet' smasanil tastak.

Ha ach lolonnak ach yet' Espíritu t'a jun a chekab' skuch David ayik yalannakkan icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj tz'el wek'ek'ok yaw heb' ch'ok chonhab'il sk'echaanh? ¿Tas wal yuj slajtiej sb'a heb' t'a junok tas manh ol tzak'wan heb' sb'oani?

Ha heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh yajal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', schichonoch sk'ool heb' winh, smolb'an sb'a heb' winh, junlajanxonhej syutej slajtian sb'a heb' winh t'a spatik winh Yajal yet' t'a spatik winh rey sik'b'ilel uuj, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

T'a wal yel, a winhaj Herodes, winhaj Poncio Pilato, heb' manh israelok yet' pax heb' israel, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik. Ix slajtian sb'a heb' t'a spatik Uninal, haton jun sik'b'ilelta uuj, haton jun ak'b'ilkan yopisio uuj.
Ix laj sb'o heb' jantaknhej tas alb'ilkan uuj t'a peka', yujto elnakxo t'a a k'ool to icha chi' sk'ulej heb'.
Haxo tiknaik Mamin, ina wal heb' tik, ste kot yowal heb' t'ayonh. Yuj chi', ak' ko tek'anil yik max onh xiw kalanel a lolonel, yujto a chekab' onh.
Ak' wal a poder t'ayonh, yik wach' ol b'oxok sk'ool heb' penaay. Ak' ko b'o juntzanh milagro sch'oxanel a poder, yujnhej Uninal haton Jesús, sik'b'ilkaneli, xchi heb' t'a Dios.

Ayik ix lajwi slesalwi heb' chi', haxo jun pat b'aj ayek' heb' chi' ix te tzikub'tanhaj yuj Dios. Ix te och wal Yespíritu Dios yet' heb' smasanil. Yuj chi' ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' yalanel slolonel Dios chi'.

Jantaknhej heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool, jun lajannhej ix yutej spensar heb'. Junk'olalxonhej ix aj heb'. Malaj junok mach ix halan yikok junok tas sch'okoj. Yujto a jantaknhej tas ay t'a heb', junnhej ix yutej heb' smasanil.
Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús ix tek'b'an sb'a yalaneli to ix pitzwixi Kajal Jesús chi'. Haxo Dios ix och yet' heb' creyente smasanil.
Malaj junok mach meb'a' ix ajkan t'a skal heb', yujto a jantaknhej heb' ay sluum ma spat, ix laj schonhel heb'. Haxo stojol ix yik'kot heb'.
Ix yak'anoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' schekab' Jesús chi'. Haxo heb' ix pukanb'at t'a heb' creyente chi', hato syala' tas tz'och yuj junjun heb'.
Ay jun winh creyente skuch José, ix ak'ji skuch Bernabé yuj heb' schekab' Jesús. Ha Bernabé syalelk'ochi, Ak'umoch Tek'anil. Ha winh chi' yinhtilalkan Leví winh, aj chonhab' Chipre winh.
Ay jun sluum winh ix schonheli. Ix yik'ankot stojol winh, ix ul yak'ankan winh t'a heb' schekab' Jesús.
